[Guarded programs](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/deeper/ExplanatoryGuardedPrograms.lean) use skip, native activity, a native question as guard, sequencing and finite choice. Conditions are tested **at the position reached when the guard occurs**. Skip can represent an explicitly selected early ending; it does not erase the preceding history or declare every unfinished path successful. The guard's semantic evaluation has no physical event or cost in this model. Its actual acquisition, reliability and material implementation are not proved by this construction.

[Residuals](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/deeper/ExplanatoryResiduals.lean) record a remaining recipe and reached native conditions in one unfolding relation. Both change through that relation from a specified initial configuration. They are analytical coordinates, not independently constituted substances. When a native model already includes the material organization specifying what remains, an additional physically separate “program object” is unnecessary; the present representation does not prove otherwise.

## 28. What the guarded extension proves

The recipe-to-question theorem compiles every finite guarded continuation into the existing native modal language. Choice uses a Boolean encoding with classical dependencies disclosed in the receipt. Fixed finite words embed exactly into this grammar. Every execution and every finite recipe history projects to a native trace with the same endpoints; guard and administrative steps are explicitly erased as semantic bookkeeping, not claimed to be free material operations.

Finite native successors imply finite endpoints for each finite recipe, including state-dependent branch selection. Complete translated macro answers at the initial compared positions, together with finite successors on the receiving side, force matching finite recipe histories. The two descriptions may use different native events, words and guarded recipes. Their **macro boundary** answers remain aligned. This does not force all internal residual positions to match.

There is a further stronger, separately scoped theorem: for the **same recipe syntax** and agreement on **all native questions**, receiving-side finite branching matches every partial history, preserving both its residual recipe and all reached-position answers. Thus the internal correspondence is recovered under explicit stronger coverage; it is not inferred from the weaker boundary premise that failed in §24.

## 29. Resumption retains what formed and what remains

A partial path of the residual unfolding is a `Cut`. `cut_resume` proves that executing the actual remaining recipe from the actual reached position completes the original recipe. `execution_iff_completed_cut` proves the converse as well: big-step execution is exactly residual unfolding to skip. Partial paths concatenate, and each has a native history. These statements have empty Lean axiom reports; their supplied process and recipe semantics remain substantive inputs.

If native activity is inserted while a recipe is paused, the new execution must start at the **changed** position. `resumption_after_inserted_history` joins the earlier native prefix, inserted history and actual resumed suffix into one native trace. It deliberately does not call the inserted trace an execution of the uninterrupted original recipe. Whether such insertion is available in an actual implementation is a correspondence obligation.

If the reached position before and after an insertion agrees on all native questions, `same_preserves_resumption` shows that all finite guarded continuation questions agree too, without a finite-branching premise. This is a sufficient preservation condition, not a claim that insertions normally satisfy it. The concrete inserted-activity failure below violates that premise by changing whether finish is possible.

## 30. Three substantive tests in the inherited unfolding

The [cases](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/deeper/ExplanatoryResumptionCases.lean) reuse the previous origin/risky/safe/ready/blocked/done law. No independent success, loss or value predicate is added.

1. **Testing before formation can select the wrong branch for a reached-position task.** At safe, finish is unavailable; begin reaches ready, where finish is available. The adaptive recipe first begins and then checks, reaching done. Moving that same check before begin instead ends at ready. This is a failure of that particular transformation, not a claim that all early checks are erroneous. `guard_hoisting_sound` gives the positive condition: when the prefix preserves the guard's answer at every admitted endpoint, moving the test earlier preserves the execution relation. From risky, the adaptive recipe may reach either done or blocked; the explicit early-ending branch remains represented.
2. **Native conditions alone can omit the remaining organization.** One initial choice recipe has two partial paths from the same safe position to the same native ready position, leaving finish pending on one and skip on the other. A continuation question distinguishes them: after executing the remainder, is finish unavailable? Any exact account of these paused-program questions must retain that difference; Reduced is not assumed. This does not exhibit identical complete physical situations with different futures. The native coordinate omitted the residual organization, and the paired configuration retains it.
3. **Inserted activity can consume a pending continuation.** The same native finish activity takes ready to done. A pending finish was executable at ready and is unavailable at done. The preceding begin/finish native history still exists. The error would be resuming from the stale ready position, not admitting the intervening change or preserving the history.

The proposed invariant is now more precise: an explanation of a particular partial unfolding's continuations must retain the consequential relation between **how that unfolding reached its present conditions and which continuation remains**. This is an inference about the specified query task, supported by the concrete exact-account separation. Its unrestricted applicability to every explanation remains unproved.

部分展开现在明确保留“到达的条件”和“还剩下的程序”，两者由同一展开关系共同产生。Lean 证明：从该位置执行真实剩余部分，恰好接续原程序；原程序的完整执行也恰好对应展开到结束。所有部分路径都能投到原生历史，衔接时不重置条件。

## 108. 提前判断、遗漏余项与插入活动的实查

同一已有模型给出三个具体检验。第一，形成前不能完成，形成后却能完成；把到达后的判断移到起点，会改变程序结果。正面修复也已证明：若前段活动的每个可达结果都保持这项判断，则提前判断有效。

第二，同一个初始程序可以到达同一个原生条件，却留下不同余项；一个还要完成，另一个已经结束。它们对剩余活动的后果回答不同，任何精确说明都必须保留这个区别。这不是完整物理状态相同却凭空产生不同未来；它指出只读原生条件的投影遗漏了已经分化的程序组织。若完整状态本已包含该组织，就不必增设一个独立本体。

第三，插入同一过程允许的活动可以耗尽原来待用的接续条件。此前历史仍然成立，接续则必须从改变后的位置开始。Lean 已把前段、插入活动和实际后段接为一条原生历史，并保留“插入后的路径不自动是原来未中断程序的执行”这一范围。

C30.claim_en: Independently specified acquisition, error and continuation questions require native distinctions and shared boundaries. Joining probes further recover finite-fragment interfaces; the ternary relation determines unique unit roles, and complete finite traces recover their state interfaces. Global accounts remain eligible; capacity limits matching-unit sufficiency. The latest concrete summary-sufficiency proof derives an effective law and exact finite-history correspondence from the unchanged mechanism, without a separate Exact or homomorphism premise. The universal attempt characterizes arbitrary ternary-relation recovery: complete success answers and minimum states/edges still allow nonisomorphic mechanisms; deterministic reachable continuation-separated realizations recover uniqueness. The continuation derives finite-branch bisimulation from compound questions at shared conditions and reconstructs code histories lifting from every compatible native start; scoped structural uniqueness no longer requires determinism. Successor compactness further replaces finite branching, preserving structural correspondence and lifting whole infinite code runs; a genuinely infinitely branching positive model contrasts with equal finite-modal answers but different infinite realization. Joint questions further force step/joint correspondence under explicit correlated-pair compactness and lift finite nodewise plans; acquisition/release derives shared-support conflict. Complete isolated joint profiles can still lose designated-part aliasing, recovered by fixed-partner questions in the finite witness. Complete descendant support and sibling exclusion further connect arbitrary finite plans to distinct global requests and a common holding history; omission failures and a positive repair are checked. Every fixed n-ary success list can still miss an (n+1)-ary capacity restriction. Formation, withdrawal, acquisition and release have exact certificate-preservation conditions; every permitted finite history has a completing suffix in the same native law. Static lists can lose actual occupation, release/formation renew readiness, and an infinite permitted schedule can still never progress. All finite first-order identity, step and joint truths, even preserved by one coherent elementary map on every finite source tuple, do not force native isomorphism of wholly root-reachable worlds. Cantor gives a genuine obstruction; adding global coverage yields isomorphism. Following Ren’s nondual objection, the counterexample is not accepted as a stopping test for a common necessary generative basis: reachability between supplied positions does not explain their constitution. After correction, all finite contexts arise from the same partial joining law. Exact accounts must retain differences affecting continuation and have a common factor even when redundant. Functional fragment joining induces a common operation. All nested joining questions on admitted histories recover exactly their beginning/ending interface while internal event differences remain real. The continuation permits multivalued joining itself: finite outcome fibers and richer branch questions force a common joining relation; each code result lifts from the originally specified inputs. Partners in questions translate through the same encoding, and every finite joining tree lifts. The common account can retain two distinguishable outcomes. Across different fragment carriers, incidence agreement yields a common refinement with one-position lifting and a unique join-preserving factor commuting with given projections. Unanchored incidence questions nevertheless collapse all local-unit fragments, losing the spent history’s impossible self-join. Retaining two reference slots in the same configuration recovers matched finite formation histories; exact accounts must distinguish idle and spent histories within one process. Finite blocks arise from paths of the same process and all block questions compile exactly. Receiving-side finite branching and translated-answer agreement match histories with different native lengths. All nonempty-prefix questions can still omit intermediate loss; suffix tests at the actual reached position restore the distinction.

This separate 54 (23+31) / 128 audit study has 105 empty and 23 propext-only lists. Probe access, state content and completion are explicit; identification with shared-capacity/concurrent conflicts remains open. New 14 theorems / 18 empty audits; 192 inherited maps unchanged (150 empty, 42 standard), independently reviewed. Existing controller/oxygen evidence is integrated without equating those cases with this construction or completing universal grounding. Overlapping imports are not added. This separate round adds 61 theorems / 135 audits (123 empty, 12 inherited propext; all new 61 empty). Existing effective-law results remain credited. Universal separation of native relations remains unwarranted; the scoped counterexample does not globally refute the conjecture. This round: 45 new theorems / 141 audits, 103 empty and 38 standard; new 19 empty and 26 standard, including 13 with classical choice. Finite branching, question coverage and reduction/separation are explicit; forward adequacy does not recover every actual past or prove universal explanatory scope. This round adds 36 theorems / 159 audits (102 empty, 57 standard; new 5 empty, 31 standard). Successor compactness is an explicit sufficient condition, not a universal law or finite-observation inference; whole continuation, actual history and general joint realization retain distinct scopes. This round adds 56 theorems / 183 audits (112 empty, 71 standard; new 6 empty, 50 standard). Pair compactness, question coverage and separation are explicit; nodewise joint plans do not establish arbitrary substitution or global concurrency, and universal uniqueness remains unproved. This round adds 37 theorems / 184 audits (115 empty, 69 standard; new 4 empty, 33 standard). Fixed access, persistent holding and operational correspondence are explicit; overapproximating footprints are sufficient certificates, and overlap alone is not failure. General dynamic joint realization and universal uniqueness remain unproved. This round adds 42 theorems / 211 audits (119 empty, 92 standard; new 6 empty, 36 standard, no new classical-choice dependency). Continuous readiness is stronger than eventual success after repair; atomic steps, full mediation and current-state access are explicit, and universal uniqueness remains unproved. This round adds 33 theorems / 180 audits (113 empty, 67 standard; new 2 empty and 31 standard, 13 with classical choice). The inference from first-order content to global coverage has a proved wall. This is not unrestricted truth adequacy or a refutation of a shared necessary generative foundation; universal foundation uniqueness remains open. Corrected current status: retain every proved result, withdraw the stopping judgment for common-foundation uniqueness, and remove the unearned global-bijection gate. Investigate constituted distinctions and necessary explanatory relations within one unfolding. No new proof; nonduality does not establish universality. This round adds 38 theorems / 166 audits (125 empty, 41 standard; new 20 empty and 18 standard, no added classical choice). The underlying process may branch; fixed-history joining is functional. Laws, semantic possibility and acquired inquiry are distinguished. Universal explanatory correspondence remains open, without treating whole-world isomorphism or this unproved bridge as a stopping wall. New 26 declarations (including adapters/applications, not 26 independent discoveries) / 223 audits: new 6 empty and 20 standard, 8 with classical choice; 197 inherited audits are separate. Removing functionality enriches tests and constrains fibers. Native identity, probabilities, shared resources and applicability to every explanation are not claimed; the next connection is warranted translation across different relational articulations. This round: 43 new declarations / 256 audits (213 inherited; new 9 empty and 34 standard, 7 with classical choice). Incidence refinement uses local finiteness and connectivity; reference repair uses equal initial slot counts, complete answer agreement and finite fixed-pair outcomes. It licenses no physical copying and does not identify graph paths with temporal execution. Actual correspondence and operation-granularity changes remain open. 2026-10-09: 23 new declarations / 279 closure audits, 256 inherited separate; all new use standard dependencies, 3 include classical choice. Fixed finite expansion, complete question agreement and actual correspondence remain explicit. Singleton coverage is sufficient to align reduced kernels; variable expansion, intermediate-reference translation and universal uniqueness remain open.

C30.claim_zh: 独立指定的取得、错误与后续问题要求保留实际差异和共同边界；接合探针进一步恢复有限片段接口，三元关系唯一确定局部单位，完整有限轨迹恢复其状态接口。整体表述仍合格，容量反例限定接口匹配的充分性。 最新从原有机制直接证明摘要充分性，推出有效规律与全部有限历史精确对应，不另给Exact或同态前提。 普遍化检验给出任意三元关系恢复的充要条件；完整成功答案与最少状态／边仍允许不同构机制，确定且可达、后续可区分时恢复唯一对应。 后续以共同条件下的复合接续问题推出有限分支双模拟，并由准确约简答案构造可从每个相容原生起点提升的编码规律；结构唯一性不再要求确定性。 再以后继紧致性放宽有限分支，取得结构对应及完整无限编码路径提升；有无限多个可区分后继的正例，也有全部有限复合答案相同而无限持续不同的反例。 共同问题再在明示成对紧致性下迫出步骤／接合对应并提升有限逐节点方案；实际占用／释放推出共享冲突。全部孤立共同问题仍可能遗漏指定部分的共享身份，固定搭配问题在有限实例中恢复。 再以完整下层支持覆盖及同级独占支持分离，将任意有限方案接到全局无重复与一次共同占用历史；遗漏关系的失败及修复正例均检查。每个固定 n 阶成功清单仍可漏掉 n+1 阶共享容量限制。 变化中的形成、撤去、占用与释放具有精确证书保持条件；任意允许有限历史在同一原生规律内都有完成后缀。静态清单会遗漏实际占用，释放／形成可恢复或建立准备；无限允许调度仍可能永不推进目标。 全体有限一阶身份、生成和接合真值一致，甚至有一个保留任意有限参数公式的映射，仍不足以迫出全范围可达结构的原生同构；Cantor 对角线给出真实不同构对手。保真映射再有全局覆盖则恢复同构。 Ren 非二元批评后的纠正：原反例未对准共同必要生成基础，不能作为原目标停止证据；给定位置之间可达未解释其构成性形成。 纠正后由同一部分接合关系形成全部有限情境，准确说明必须保留改变接续可能性的区别，冗余说明亦有共同因子；固定片段接合结果唯一时，共同内容带有唯一对应的操作。实际历史的全部嵌套接合问题恰好保留开始／结束接口，不抹去不同内部事件。 后续允许接合本身有多个结果：有限结果纤维及更丰富的分支问答迫出共同接合关系，原指定输入能实现每个代码结果；检验伙伴随同一编码转换，任意有限接合树提升。共同表示仍可有两个可区分结果。 不共用片段载体时，关联同测可导出单位置接合的共同细化及与既有投影相容的唯一保接合因子；但无引用关联问题会使所有有局部单位的片段同测，遗漏已消耗历史的不可自接合。保留同一配置的两个引用位置后，跨载体的有限形成历史可以匹配，精确说明必区分同一过程的空历史与已消耗历史。 有限宏步骤由同一过程路径形成，完整宏问答可精确翻译；接收侧有限分支及翻译问答一致迫出不同原生步数的有限历史匹配。全部非空前缀问答仍可遗漏中途失续；在实际到达位置开放后缀检验可恢复区别。 有限条件程序进一步按已到达条件分支或提前结束；宏问答恢复之外，相同语法与全部原生问答同测可匹配每个部分历史并保留余项。完整执行恰好等于展开到结束；同起点同原生位置的余项差异迫使精确说明区分。插入活动可使待用接续失效，实际前中后段仍接为一条历史。

Successor compactness further replaces finite branching, preserving structural correspondence and lifting whole infinite code runs; a genuinely infinitely branching positive model contrasts with equal finite-modal answers but different infinite realization. Joint questions further force step/joint correspondence under explicit correlated-pair compactness and lift finite nodewise plans; acquisition/release derives shared-support conflict. Complete isolated joint profiles can still lose designated-part aliasing, recovered by fixed-partner questions in the finite witness. Complete descendant support and sibling exclusion further connect arbitrary finite plans to distinct global requests and a common holding history; omission failures and a positive repair are checked. Execution equals unfolding to skip; different residuals at one reached native position force exact accounts to distinguish them. Inserted activity can disable a pending continuation while the actual joined history remains.

F22.claim_zh: 继承校准、结构对手、组合唯一性及实际展开的接合／替换、分支继续与同规律错误反例；另增空历史探针、局部单位唯一性与关系同构下保持、完整接续充要条件和整个状态接口恢复。容量及内部序列丢失反例保留。 最新从原有机制直接证明摘要充分性，推出有效规律与全部有限历史精确对应，不另给Exact或同态前提。 普遍化检验给出任意三元关系恢复的充要条件；完整成功答案与最少状态／边仍允许不同构机制，确定且可达、后续可区分时恢复唯一对应。 后续以共同条件下的复合接续问题推出有限分支双模拟，并由准确约简答案构造可从每个相容原生起点提升的编码规律；结构唯一性不再要求确定性。 再以后继紧致性放宽有限分支，取得结构对应及完整无限编码路径提升；有无限多个可区分后继的正例，也有全部有限复合答案相同而无限持续不同的反例。 共同问题再在明示成对紧致性下迫出步骤／接合对应并提升有限逐节点方案；实际占用／释放推出共享冲突。全部孤立共同问题仍可能遗漏指定部分的共享身份，固定搭配问题在有限实例中恢复。 再以完整下层支持覆盖及同级独占支持分离，将任意有限方案接到全局无重复与一次共同占用历史；遗漏关系的失败及修复正例均检查。每个固定 n 阶成功清单仍可漏掉 n+1 阶共享容量限制。 变化中的形成、撤去、占用与释放具有精确证书保持条件；任意允许有限历史在同一原生规律内都有完成后缀。静态清单会遗漏实际占用，释放／形成可恢复或建立准备；无限允许调度仍可能永不推进目标。 全体有限一阶身份、生成和接合真值一致，甚至有一个保留任意有限参数公式的映射，仍不足以迫出全范围可达结构的原生同构；Cantor 对角线给出真实不同构对手。保真映射再有全局覆盖则恢复同构。 Ren 非二元批评后的纠正：原反例未对准共同必要生成基础，不能作为原目标停止证据；给定位置之间可达未解释其构成性形成。 纠正后由同一部分接合关系形成全部有限情境，准确说明必须保留改变接续可能性的区别，冗余说明亦有共同因子；固定片段接合结果唯一时，共同内容带有唯一对应的操作。实际历史的全部嵌套接合问题恰好保留开始／结束接口，不抹去不同内部事件。 后续允许接合本身有多个结果：有限结果纤维及更丰富的分支问答迫出共同接合关系，原指定输入能实现每个代码结果；检验伙伴随同一编码转换，任意有限接合树提升。共同表示仍可有两个可区分结果。 不共用片段载体时，关联同测可导出单位置接合的共同细化及与既有投影相容的唯一保接合因子；但无引用关联问题会使所有有局部单位的片段同测，遗漏已消耗历史的不可自接合。保留同一配置的两个引用位置后，跨载体的有限形成历史可以匹配，精确说明必区分同一过程的空历史与已消耗历史。 有限宏步骤由同一过程路径形成，完整宏问答可精确翻译；接收侧有限分支及翻译问答一致迫出不同原生步数的有限历史匹配。全部非空前缀问答仍可遗漏中途失续；在实际到达位置开放后缀检验可恢复区别。 有限条件程序进一步按已到达条件分支或提前结束；宏问答恢复之外，相同语法与全部原生问答同测可匹配每个部分历史并保留余项。完整执行恰好等于展开到结束；同起点同原生位置的余项差异迫使精确说明区分。插入活动可使待用接续失效，实际前中后段仍接为一条历史。

Functional fragment joining induces a common operation. All nested joining questions on admitted histories recover exactly their beginning/ending interface while internal event differences remain real. The continuation permits multivalued joining itself: finite outcome fibers and richer branch questions force a common joining relation; each code result lifts from the originally specified inputs. Partners in questions translate through the same encoding, and every finite joining tree lifts. The common account can retain two distinguishable outcomes. Across different fragment carriers, incidence agreement yields a common refinement with one-position lifting and a unique join-preserving factor commuting with given projections. Unanchored incidence questions nevertheless collapse all local-unit fragments, losing the spent history’s impossible self-join. Retaining two reference slots in the same configuration recovers matched finite formation histories; exact accounts must distinguish idle and spent histories within one process. Finite blocks arise from paths of the same process and all block questions compile exactly. Receiving-side finite branching and translated-answer agreement match histories with different native lengths. All nonempty-prefix questions can still omit intermediate loss; suffix tests at the actual reached position restore the distinction. Finite guarded recipes branch or end at reached conditions. Beyond macro recovery, common syntax and complete native-answer agreement match partial histories with residuals retained. Execution equals unfolding to skip; different residuals at one reached native position force exact accounts to distinguish them. Inserted activity can disable a pending continuation while the actual joined history remains.
